answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a prism through which capital filters influence, forcing agents to lock collateral to participate in consensus. Unlike a sable cloak hiding identity, this mechanism creates a financial ridge that attackers must climb. By tying decision-making power to staked tokens rather than ephemeral addresses, the system imposes a prohibitive cost on Sybil creation, as any attempt to inflate influence requires the acquisition of assets that scale linearly with the attack's scope.
